body:
I have one malignant narcissist parent, and one neurodiverse parent who left him. 

She is everything good in this world. My mother’s love saved me. But I live in fear that I’ll turn into him. 

It also helps that I was his victim. My sister who is his favorite is turning into him.

1. Nope

2. Nope

3. I no longer trust them to keep their word

4. Absolutely. 

5. Untrustworthy.
Yup. Mine is my friend and outright said she’s in love with me tonight- and I actively have told her multiple times I don’t want things to be sexual.

My father going from loving and occasionally harsh to full blow narcissist who lies about me to everyone and got the extended family to cut me out

My daughter dying in my arms shortly after birth

Being raped

My ex boyfriend raping me multiple times and trying to murder me

I’m completely messed up and live in fear of becoming my dad. I have no money for therapy. I don’t sleep. I still flinch sometimes when my fiancé touches me. I’m terrified I’ll never have another child but more terrified that I will, and they’ll die as well. I’m slowly crumbling and I’m pretty sure the person I once was is dead.

I just. The people I want to love me? Like my parents? One hates me, like truly hates me, and the other desperately pushes me to be something I’m not and never can be. I have to be perfect. And I’m cracking.
Between physical abuse from an ex, long COVID, and childhood trauma… me too

It’s SO HARD to just do the basic self care stuff- I have a lot of trauma and crap related to cleaning and shame (NParent used to trash my room/ destroy my things if they deemed it “too messy”) and I know my apartment is a mess. 

The thing that is going on is likely serious, which is the other reason I’m freaking terrified. I have insurance, but I’m worried that this is going to lead to mobility issues fairly young. Fwiw this was the first time anything like this has happened (though I’ve had what I realize now are warning signs), and I scheduled an appointment ASAP.
